data.one_liner: A wrapper around url_launcher for opening URLs, emails, phone calls, and SMS.
data.what_it_does: Simplifies the process of launching URLs, making phone calls, sending SMS and emails, opening maps, and messaging WhatsApp directly. It is built on top of the url_launcher package.
use_when: You want a simpler API for url_launcher features like calls, emails, and SMS
You need to quickly open URLs, maps, or WhatsApp chats from your app
avoid_when: You need fine-grained control over low-level URL launching behavior not exposed by the wrapper
strengths: Convenience methods for WhatsApp, Google Maps, SMS, and calls
weaknesses: Relies on an extra wrapper layer instead of using url_launcher directly

alternatives.name: url_launcher
alternatives.why_pick_it: It is the official underlying package maintained by the Flutter team.
